Great Expectations

Annotated Edition

Pip, a young orphan, meets an escaped convict on the marshes and is invited to the strange Satis House of Miss Havisham. When a secret benefactor gives him the chance to become a gentleman, everything he thought he wanted begins to change.

Dickens first published Great Expectations in 1861. This is an annotated Kindle edition of the complete novel.

Questions

What does annotated mean?

The book includes extra notes alongside the story, such as explanations of the history and customs that a modern reader might not know.

Who wrote it?

Charles Dickens. The text is his complete original story.
